title: Modified LSK109 Ligation Prep with Needle Shear and Bead Clean Up
author: John Tyson
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.7emhjc6

steps.title: Shear HMW Genomic DNA
steps.instruction: Shear 10 µg of HMW genomic DNA made up to 250 µL with EB using 20 passes of either a 29G or 26G needle.

steps.title: First Bead Clean Up
steps.instruction: Perform bead clean up based on the needle gauge used for shearing.

substeps.instruction: For 26G shear: add 250 µL EB (10mM Tris-Cl pH8.0) followed by 250 µL AMPureXP bead solution.
For 29G shear: add 125 µL AMPureXP bead solution.
Mix by flicking.
Place on magnet, remove supernatant, and wash 2x with 300 µL – 500 µL 80% ethanol without disturbing the pellet.
Remove tube from magnet, then place back on magnet and remove eluted DNA sample to a fresh tube.

steps.title: Quantify DNA Recovery
steps.instruction: Quantify 1 µL of the DNA sample using the Qubit DNA HS kit to confirm recovery (~ 6 µg).

steps.title: First Incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate the sample at 20 °C for 00:30:00, followed by 65 °C for 00:30:00.

steps.title: Second Bead Clean Up
steps.instruction: Perform a second bead clean up to purify the DNA.

substeps.instruction: Add 120 µL EB buffer followed by 72 µL AMPureXP bead solution.
Mix by flicking.
Place on magnet, remove supernatant, and wash 2x with 300 µL 80% ethanol without disturbing the pellet.
Remove tube from magnet, then place back on magnet and remove eluted DNA sample to a fresh tube.

steps.title: Quantify DNA Recovery
steps.instruction: Quantify 1 µL DNA sample using the Qubit DNA HS kit to confirm recovery (~ 4 µg – 5 µg).

steps.title: Third Bead Clean Up
steps.instruction: Perform a third bead clean up using LFB buffer.

substeps.instruction: Add 100 µL EB buffer followed by 80 µL AMPureXP bead solution.
Mix by flicking.
Place on magnet, remove supernatant, and wash 2x with 250 µL of LFB buffer by removing from the magnet and flicking, briefly spinning, and pelleting again on the magnet.
Remove tube from magnet, then place tube on magnet and pellet beads.

steps.title: Quantify DNA Recovery
steps.instruction: Quantify 1 µL DNA sample using the Qubit DNA HS kit to confirm recovery (~ 2.5 µg).

steps.title: Final Library Preparation
steps.instruction: Prepare the library for loading (200 ng – 400 ng per load).

substeps.instruction: Incubate for 00:10:00 at Room temperature, then pellet on a magnet.
Briefly spin, return to magnet, and remove any residual 80% ethanol with a pipette.
Allow the bead pellet to air dry for ~ 00:02:00.
Resuspend the bead pellet in 51 µL EB by flicking and spin down.
Allow DNA to elute by incubation at 37 °C for 00:05:00.

steps.title: End-Prep Reaction
steps.instruction: Set up and execute the End-Prep reaction.

substeps.instruction: Combine 50 µL DNA sample, 7 µL Ultra II End-Prep Buffer, and 3 µL Ultra II End-Prep Enzyme mix.
Incubate for 00:10:00 at Room temperature, then pellet on a magnet.
Return to magnet and remove any residual 80% ethanol with a pipette.
Allow the bead pellet to air dry for ~ 00:02:00.
Resuspend the bead pellet in 67 µL EB by flicking and spin down.
Allow DNA to elute by incubation at [temperature not specified] °C for 00:05:00 with occasional flicking.

steps.title: Ligation Reaction
steps.instruction: Set up and execute the Ligation reaction.

substeps.instruction: Combine 66 µL DNA sample, 25 µL LNB buffer, 5 µL AMX adapter, and 4 µL Quick T4 DNA Ligase.
Incubate for 00:10:00 at Room temperature, then pellet on a magnet.
Remove any residual LFB buffer while on the magnet with a pipette after final pelleting.
Resuspend the bead pellet in 21 µL ONT-EB buffer by flicking and spin down.
Allow DNA to elute by incubation at 37 °C for 00:05:00.
Remove eluted DNA sample to a fresh tube.
